# API & Streaming Requirements Quality Checklist: Warrant X-Ray

**Purpose**: Formal release-gate review (before implementation) of API contracts, SSE streaming events, token allowlists, error envelopes, and rate-limiting specifications.
**Created**: 2026-10-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | contracts: [rest-api.md](../contracts/rest-api.md), [chat-sse.md](../contracts/chat-sse.md) | design: [plan.md](../plan.md), [tech_spec.md](../../../tech_spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Audience**: Reviewer / QA. **Depth**: Formal Release Gate. **Focus**: REST Routes, SSE Chat Stream, Error Envelope, Token Allowlists, Rate Limiting & Admin Metrics.

## REST API Contracts: Completeness & Consistency

- [ ] CHK001 Are request and response schemas specified for all 13 REST route groups without relying on informal prose descriptions? [Completeness, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the date/time string format consistently specified as UTC ISO 8601 across all API request parameters and JSON responses? [Consistency, Req §FR-API-01, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK003 Are number representation rules (e.g. fractions vs percentages, null for unknown vs omitting fields) consistently enforced across all endpoints? [Consistency, Req §FR-API-01, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification define fallback behavior for `GET /api/warrants/{code}` when the warrant code is unknown, returning up to 3 closest valid codes? [Edge Case, Req §FR-CARD-04, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK005 Are query parameter validation boundaries (e.g., limit bounds, sort fields, moneyness enums) quantified for `GET /api/warrants`? [Clarity, Req §FR-SRCH-01, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK006 Is snapshot pinning behavior (`snapshot_id` parameter) defined uniformly across all data endpoints, including fallback notice when an invalid ID is provided? [Consistency, Req §FR-DATA-08, Req §FR-ERR-21]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the 7-day recency window for `GET /api/news` specified as an immutable server-side constraint, with query overrides explicitly disallowed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the required fields and calculation formulas for `POST /api/scenario` specified to guarantee parity with the in-chat scenario tool? [Consistency, Req §FR-SCN-08, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the comparison limit constraint (minimum 2, maximum 3 same-stock warrants) defined with clear error messages for mismatched underlyings? [Clarity, Req §FR-CMP-01, Req §FR-CMP-04]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the attributes and data types returned by `GET /api/meta` specified, including public visitor counts and model tier health signals? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Contract §rest-api.md]

## Chat Stream (SSE Protocol): Event Ordering & Latency

- [ ] CHK011 Is the sequence and monotonic ID progression of SSE events (`turn_started`, `status`, `tool_call`, `evidence`, `card`, `token`, `verifier`, `usage`, `done`, `error`) strictly defined? [Completeness, Contract §chat-sse.md]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the first-event streaming latency budget (first `status` event emitted <= 3.0 s from request) specified as an objective measurable requirement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010, Contract §chat-sse.md]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the specification enforce that `token` events stream ONLY after numeric grounding and advice boundary verification have fully passed? [Consistency, Constitution §I, Contract §chat-sse.md]
- [ ] CHK014 Are heartbeat interval (15-second comment) and proxy buffering headers (`X-Accel-Buffering: no`, `Cache-Control: no-cache`) explicitly required for SSE connections? [Non-Functional, Contract §chat-sse.md]
- [ ] CHK015 Is client disconnect behavior defined to abort ongoing agent and tool execution and record partial usage immediately? [Exception Flow, Contract §chat-sse.md]
- [ ] CHK016 Are turn timeout requirements (maximum 60 seconds per turn) specified with partial verified delivery and a timeout notice? [Edge Case, Req §FR-ERR-17, Contract §chat-sse.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the static status text map for tool progression required to originate from deterministic server code rather than model-generated text? [Clarity, Req §FR-CHAT-03, Contract §chat-sse.md]

## Error Envelopes & Degradation: Clarity & Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Is the uniform error response envelope (`{"error": {"code", "message", "field"?, "retry_after"?}}`) specified for all 4xx and 5xx API failures? [Consistency, Req §FR-API-03, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK019 Are all standard error codes (`invalid_input`, `not_found`, `rate_limited`, `budget_exhausted`, `source_unavailable`, `model_unavailable`) enumerated with their triggering conditions? [Completeness, Req §FR-ERR-*, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the prohibition against leaking stack traces or internal environment details in API responses documented as a strict security requirement? [Non-Functional, Constitution §X, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for handling malformed JSON, over-length payloads (>1,000 chars), and empty chat turns before LLM invocation? [Edge Case, Req §FR-ERR-19, Contract §chat-sse.md]

## Token Allowlists & Numeric Grounding: Precision & Verification

- [ ] CHK022 Is the per-turn allowlist schema specified, containing exact server-formatted `display` strings, user-typed numbers, and evidence IDs? [Clarity, Tech §D4, Contract §chat-sse.md]
- [ ] CHK023 Are matching rules for the grounding verifier defined with exact display-string match as primary and bounded numeric tolerance as fallback? [Clarity, Req §FR-GRD-01, Tech §11]
- [ ] CHK024 Does the specification define how numbers embedded in cited news facts are validated against the allowlist? [Completeness, Req §FR-NEWS-04, Req §FR-GRD-01]
- [ ] CHK025 Are regeneration and sentence-stripping behaviors specified for drafts failing the grounding check, including the exact omission note format? [Clarity, Req §FR-GRD-02, Spec §User Story 2]

## Rate Limiting, Budgets & Admin Security: Non-Functional

- [ ] CHK026 Are client rate-limiting requirements quantified with specific thresholds (e.g. 30 requests/hour/hashed key) and distinct limits for data versus chat endpoints? [Clarity, Req §FR-CTRL-01, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the graceful degradation behavior specified when the daily LLM USD cap or Tavily credit budget is reached, returning stored/templated responses? [Edge Case, Req §FR-CTRL-02, Req §FR-ERR-18]
- [ ] CHK028 Are authentication requirements for operator admin endpoints (`GET /api/admin/metrics`, cache management) specified with bearer token verification against `WX_ADMIN_TOKEN`? [Security, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK029 Does the specification mandate that admin endpoints return a 404 Not Found rather than 401/403 when `WX_ADMIN_TOKEN` is unset in the environment? [Security, Contract §rest-api.md]

## Privacy & Visitor Session Semantics: Consistency & Compliance

- [ ] CHK030 Is the distinction between `ChatSession` (in-memory, 2-hour idle expiry) and `VisitorSession` (24-hour TTL in `X-Session-ID`) strictly reflected in the API header contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Contract §rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK031 Does the specification strictly forbid storing or logging raw client IP addresses in API access logs, usage tables, or evidence payloads? [Non-Functional, Constitution §XI, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK032 Are the salt rotation rules for the daily-salted client subnet/User-Agent cryptographic hash specified to prevent cross-day tracking? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Tech §9]

## Dependencies, Versioning & Schema Drift: Traceability

- [ ] CHK033 Is the automated generation of OpenAPI specifications (`openapi.json`) and TypeScript client types required as a blocking CI gate? [Traceability, Req §FR-API-04, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK034 Are contract tests specified to validate every REST and SSE route against the generated OpenAPI schema using synthetic fixtures? [Completeness, Contract §rest-api.md, Contract §chat-sse.md]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the response caching and ETag header contract defined for static snapshot queries to optimize repeat requests? [Non-Functional, Contract §rest-api.md]

## Notes
